sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied san-isidro-schools.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. NHS northwest roof kept separate from ES; crown belt south of NHS roof and around its exposed forecourt, small green island and narrow entry links. Parent boundary cuts through shared canopy: trunks are allocated to their own site. No hedge distinguishable from mature crowns. Crown-width observations: Mature distinguishable clumps roughly 45-65 px across the shared image; radial/edge crowns about 35-50 px. Image roof sections matched separately to complete source roof corners; excluded opposite corners on distinct roofs provide independent checks. Mapped older roof sizes differ from imagery; sections are used independently rather than smoothing incompatible dimensions across the yard. Checks establish local roof-section accuracy, not a surveyed campus-wide transformation. Visible greenery is authored relative to its nearest matched section. Independent excluded check errors: 1.42 m, 0.18 m, 0.81 m, 0.47 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
